NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 构建全栈加速计算平台，从芯片到软件全面优化，赋能数据中心级AI基础设施。
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Full-stack accelerated computing platform, from chips to software, powering data-center-scale AI infrastructure for all industries.

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 全面布局AI技术栈，以负责任和安全的方式赋能个人与组织，引领AI平台变革。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Embed AI across the stack responsibly, empowering productivity and security for every person and organization.
concrete_bets: Intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 将生成式AI与现有数据平台深度融合，打造企业级AI操作系统以驱动各类决策。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrating generative AI into core platforms to create an enterprise AI operating system for decision-making.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 将AI融入社交应用与可穿戴设备，打造下一代计算平台。
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrate AI across social apps and wearables to build next-gen computing platform.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涉及OpenAI误攻、第三方安全评估、网络安全评测及防护措施。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers OpenAI intrusion timeline, third-party cyber evals, and security evals patterns.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 讨论缩放律、推理控制、新架构、生成模型与天气数据模型。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Discusses scaling laws, reasoning effort, new architectures, diffusion, and climate models.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 聚焦Claude Code、本地编码代理、代码生成游戏及相关技术。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Focuses on Claude Code default, local coding agents, and code generation tools.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涵盖AI在税务、教育、心理健康的实际应用及模型更新。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers ChatGPT in tax, education, mental health, and model updates for users.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 广泛研究主题：数据系统、代理、科学框架、健康传感器、量子计算等。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Broad research topics: data systems, agents, science frameworks, health sensors, quantum computing.

alias.notes: Mapped variations to existing canonicals. 'Enterprise AI Platform' and '企业数据上的应用LLM' both refer to enterprise LLM applications, mapped to 'LLM/生成式AI应用'. 'AI系统可观测性' and 'Token/成本可观测' both map to 'AI系统可观测性/成本'. Variants of AI coding agent phrases map to 'AI编码agent当硬技能'. 'Prompt injection/AI安全' is a subset of 'AI安全/Responsible AI'.
